description_en: Lists the execution history of a flow
description_zh: 获取一个流程的所有历史执行
name: ListExecutions

parameters.help_en:
The name of the flow. The name must be unique within the same region and cannot be changed after the flow is created. The name must meet the following requirements:

Can contain letters (a-z and A-Z), digits (0-9), underscores (_), and hyphens (-).

Must start with a letter (a-z or A-Z) or an underscore (_).

Is case-sensitive.

Must be 1 to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
流程名称。该名称在同一地域内唯一，创建后不可修改。取值说明如下：

支持英文字符（a~z）或（A~Z）、数字（0~9）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）。
首字母必须为英文字母（a~z）、（A~Z）或下划线（_）。
区分大小写。
长度为1~128个字符
parameters.name: flow_name

parameters.help_en: The token to start the query from. Obtain the token from the response of this operation. This parameter is not required for the first query
parameters.help_zh: 执行查询开始名称，根据本接口返回获取。首次查询非必填
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of executions to query. The value must be in the range of [1, 100]. The default value is 60
parameters.help_zh: 查询数量。取值范围[1,100]，默认值为60
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en:
The status of the executions to filter. Valid values:

Starting

Running

Stopped

Succeeded

Failed

TimedOut
parameters.help_zh:
需要过滤的执行状态。取值说明如下：
Starting
Running
Stopped
Succeeded
Failed
TimedOut
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: Filters for executions that started after this time. The time must be in the UTC RFC3339 format
parameters.help_zh: 筛选某个执行的起始时间后的所有执行，格式为UTC RFC3339
parameters.name: started_time_begin

parameters.help_en: Filters for executions that started before this time. The time must be in the UTC RFC3339 format
parameters.help_zh: 筛选某个执行的起始时间前的所有执行，格式为UTC RFC3339
parameters.name: started_time_end

parameters.help_en: The prefix of the execution name
parameters.name: execution_name_prefix

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to return only the metadata of the executions. If you set this to true, the response does not include the flow definition, input, or output. If you set this to false, the response includes all data
parameters.help_zh: 是否只返回执行的元数据。为true时，返回值中不包括Flow定义、Input和Output，为false时会返回全部数据
parameters.name: metadata_only

parameters.help_en: The version or alias of the flow
parameters.help_zh: 指定流程的版本或别名
parameters.name: qualifier

parameters.help_en:
The name of the MapRun. When a MapRun is started in an execution, a MapRunStarted event is generated. You can get the MapRunName from the output of the MapRunStarted event.

You can set MapRunName to filter child executions started by a specific MapRun in the current flow
parameters.help_zh:
MapRun 名称，当 Execution 中发起 MapRun 执行后，会产生 MapRunStarted 事件，MapRunName 可以从 MapRunStarted 事件的 Output 中获取。

可以通过设置 MapRunName 过滤当前 Flow 中指定 MapRun 发起的子执行
parameters.name: map_run_name

Environment.description_zh: Flow 执行时使用的环境变量列表

Variables.description_zh: Flow 执行时使用的环境变量列表

items.description_en: The list of variables that can be accessed during the flow execution

Variables.title_zh: Flow 执行时使用的环境变量列表

FlowDefinition.description_en: The definition of the executed flow
FlowDefinition.example:
Legacy version:
"type: flow
version: v1
name: my_flow_name
steps:
 - type: pass
 name: mypass"

New version:
"Type: StateMachine
SpecVersion: v1
Name: my_flow_name
StartAt: my_state
States:
 - Type: Pass
 Name: my_state
 End: true"

Input.description_en: The input of the execution, in JSON object format
Input.description_zh: 执行的输入，为JSON对象格式

Output.description_en: The output of the execution, in JSON object format
Output.description_zh: 执行的输出，为JSON对象格式

StartedTime.description_en: The time when the execution started

StoppedTime.description_en: The time when the execution stopped

NextToken.description_en:
The token to start the next query. This parameter is not returned if no more data is available.

This parameter might not appear in the response if there are no more results
NextToken.description_zh:
下个查询起始Key，如无其他数据则不返回。

返回结果中，可能因为没有下一页内容不显示该参数
